summary: claims.rs (ADR-0015): Claim::renew is now bounded by Claim::max_expiry (4 TTLs, max 4 h from claimed_at); new Claim::reassert restarts the age; ClaimBook::renew reasserts; Granted gained absorbed_paths (serde default, skipped when empty); new Reaped/LostLease types; ttl clamped on load

summary: Tasks/contracts audit: TaskBoard::update and State::task_update take force: bool; TaskBoard::reap_orphans + State per-agent last_seen reap in_progress tasks of silent owners (default 1800 s, set_task_orphan_secs, serve --task-orphan-secs); StatusReport.tasks_orphaned; NewContract.consumers is Option<Vec<RepoPath>> (None keeps existing) + expected_version: Option<u32>; Published.notify is the old+new consumer union the contract notice goes to; new TaskError::OwnedByOther and ContractError::VersionConflict map to status conflict; tool inputs task_update.force and contract_publish.expected_version.
from: update(agent, id, status, note, now); NewContract { consumers: Vec<RepoPath>, .. }; any agent could take/close another's in_progress task; republish without consumers wiped them
to: update(agent, id, status, note, force, now); NewContract { consumers: Option<Vec<RepoPath>>, expected_version: Option<u32>, .. }; conflict {owner, since} unless force; conflict {current_version, published_by} on stale expected_version

summary: Daemon shutdown no longer waits for idle SSE streams: ServerHandle::shutdown signals graceful shutdown, waits at most SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE (2 s), aborts the server task, then syncs the persister and removes daemon.json only when it still records this process's pid. `tirith serve` also stops on SIGTERM and when its repository root disappears (checked every 2 s). The shim's restart path can rely on the old pid exiting within ~3 s of SIGINT.
from: shutdown waited for every open connection; daemon.json removed unconditionally; serve stopped only on ctrl-c
to: 2 s deadline then abort; daemon.json removed only if pid matches; serve stops on ctrl-c, SIGTERM, or a vanished root
